title: Momoi Airi — Pro Give And Take〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Hanamioka Town Hall

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But we finished building the stage!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank goodness we were able to complete it in time for the event! Now we'll be able to cheer all the runners on!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. We can't let the runners show us up. We've got to sing and dance our hearts out to make this marathon an even more exciting event!
Good work, you two.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Oh!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Boss!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Here. The wife made you something.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow!
These rice balls are loaded with different ingredients!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And they're still warm!
Thank you for always being so kind!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: No big deal. She does it because she wants to.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, we really appreciate it.
Come on, let's have these while they're still warm!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Minori
rows.Line:
Let's eat!
Let's dig in!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Mmm!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
This really hits the spot.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
These rice balls are so good!
The chicken and wild herbs are perfectly cooked!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line:
Yeah?
She'll love hearing that.

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line:
...
I saw the stage you two put up. Came together really nice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
...!
Thank you very much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We wouldn't have been able to do it without everyone's help.

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: You got the hang of things pretty quick, Hanasato. And you were solid from the start, Momoi. But most important, you two've got guts.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You know it!
You're not gonna get an idol to break that easily!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Really? Not sure what being an idol has to do with it.

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: But, I'm glad your stage turned out as well as it did.

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Say, I got a question for you two.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? For us?

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Just, try not to laugh...

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: How can I get better at singing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? Singing?

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Yeah. Next town meeting we're doing karaoke, and I have to sing. It's not really my thing...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, I see...
I kind of get that from you.

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line:
How?
In any case, I'm not about to embarrass myself in front of any youngsters...

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: So, I was hoping I could get some professional advice.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... How to become a better singer...

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Look, I'm not putting lipstick on a pig here. I'm not gonna be good. I just don't want to look nervous.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A way to not feel nervous...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I have just the solution!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yes, all you have to do is...
Sing loud and sing proud!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Sing loud and sing proud...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You already know how to project your voice really loudly from your gut, Boss.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And that volume is really important when it comes to singing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: She's right! I could always hear your voice really clearly even from super far away!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line:
Well, thanks and all...
But is that really all there is to it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Obviously, you have to practice in order to learn how to use techniques like vibrato and falsetto well...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But singing isn't just about whether or not you're good at it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Even if you aren't a great singer, you can leave a big impression just by putting in an honest effort!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It's true, that can really make someone shine!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So just have confidence! Stand up on that stage and go, “Here I am!” And it should all work out.

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line:
Alright, got it.
I'll give it a shot.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Great!
I'm sure everyone's going to love the way you sing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Break a leg!

rows.Speaker: Local Carpenter
rows.Line: Alright, thanks!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Hehe. He seems to be feeling much better now. I'm so glad that we could help.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Well, after saying all that, I can't back down myself. We're gonna sing and dance on that stage we built...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (And give energy to everyone who comes to the marathon!)
